title: distribution.json
description: Cross-platform distribution plan emitted AFTER a YouTube upload (D-027). The Distributor port (pipeline/07-distribute/distributor.mjs) builds this from publish.json + the uploaded video URL, then a provider (Postiz, self-hosted/free) posts each derivative. SEAM defined in Wave 4 (T4.3); the live Postiz adapter + the after-upload write are wired in Wave 5 (T5.3). All posts honor the altered-content disclosure (D-025).

source_url.description: Watch URL of the long video; derivatives link back to it.

provider.description: Which distributor posts these (e.g. postiz, noop).

posts.description: One entry per derivative to publish. Wave 4 emits the Short cross-post; Wave 5 adds link/pin/blog.

caption.description: Post text (the Short's one-line cross-post caption, D-038).

channels.description: Target channel handles for this post kind.

status.description: Lifecycle (default pending; set by the distributor in Wave 5).
